source_snapshot.procedure: Enable EGM at Device Manager > Vera Configuration > EGM, boot OS and check lsmem near 1.7 TB; disable EGM, boot again and check lsmem near 1.5 TB; preserve results/photos and post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both OS boots succeed, Enable/Disable is selectable, and enabled EGM exposes more OS memory than disabled EGM.
source_snapshot.script: No Master script; 20 attended/40 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires operator setting and reboot but substitutes nvidia-smi memory.total, which reports GPU-local VRAM rather than the Master's OS-visible lsmem population.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; improves state and recovery evidence but retains the same VRAM-versus-host-memory command mismatch.

old_problem: The historical record correctly exposed the VRAM/host-memory mismatch but left EGM semantics, exact totals, control surface and recovery as an Engineering Decision even though the Master already defines a reversible two-state host-memory comparison and the missing platform values can be signed runtime configuration.
disposition_reason: ED-01/03/05/06 permit the exact EGM state labels, host-memory byte ranges, NUMA placement, units and tolerances to be bound before execution while preserving the clear enable-boot-measure-disable-boot-measure intent. The review-layer oracle is corrected to complete lsmem, memory-block and NUMA evidence; nvidia-smi memory.total is corroborative only. Operator-owned configuration changes and reboots, workload isolation, aborts and recovery keep the case safe without inventing an OEM command or threshold.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2197, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2 and historical record were read directly; skipped baseline row 2198 and actual next formal row Functionality 2199 / Wistron-HW-00480-V002 / f50435d098866625 were also directly read before this record.
Preserve the Master's EGM enable then disable ordering, two successful OS boots, approximate 1.7-TB/1.5-TB examples and larger-when-enabled relationship.
Bind EGM architectural meaning, Vera control surface, platform identity, exact byte totals/ranges/NUMA placement and decimal/binary units/tolerance from signed project configuration.
Use full lsmem --bytes --output-all, /proc/meminfo, memory-block and NUMA evidence after each boot; GPU/fabric data establishes health and identity, not the host-memory acceptance total.
An authorized operator alone changes EGM and performs the two controlled reboots; the agent does not toggle, reboot, clear logs, retry a failed state or perform recovery.
The original sequence ends disabled, so DISABLED is the default restoration state unless the signed project recipe explicitly requires another final state.
No DUT setting change, reboot, query, test, retry or recovery was executed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized EGM state transition and OS-visible host-memory topology validation
test_case.purpose: Verify that the approved EGM control reversibly changes the intended OS-visible host-memory population and topology between enabled and disabled states, while both controlled boots, GPU/fabric health and final restoration remain acceptable.
required_package: Signed EGM architecture definition and Vera control-surface/state mapping
Platform/GPU/CPU/firmware/BIOS/driver identity and approved state-change/reboot recipe
Enabled and disabled host-memory byte totals, ranges, NUMA placement, units and tolerance
Workload-drain, boot/readiness, error/abort and final-state/recovery criteria
lsmem, /proc/meminfo, memory-block/NUMA and approved GPU/fabric/log collection access
test_case.test_command: After workload drain and operator confirmation, preserve baseline evidence. The authorized operator enables the exact EGM control and performs one approved reboot; after OS readiness collect complete `lsmem --bytes --output-all`, `/proc/meminfo`, online memory-block/NUMA topology, GPU/fabric health and preserved kernel/EDAC/AER/XID/SEL evidence. The operator then disables EGM, performs the second approved reboot, and the same collectors capture the disabled dataset. Compare signed byte/range/node values and restore the signed final state without automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: Both approved boots reach OS Ready; state evidence matches the requested control value; enabled and disabled host-memory totals/ranges/NUMA placement match their signed oracles, with enabled memory larger as required; GPU/fabric and system logs remain within signed limits; the system finishes in the required state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when both state labels, OS-ready proofs, complete host-memory/NUMA datasets, signed byte/range/tolerance comparison, health/error limits and final state all match. A missing/incorrect delta, topology loss, boot/health/error anomaly or failed restoration is FAIL. Missing signed semantics, totals, tolerance, control mapping or recovery is BLOCKED at execution, not an Engineering Decision Pending review. `nvidia-smi memory.total` alone can never PASS this case.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until EGM semantics, exact target/control, state values, workload drain, two-reboot authorization, host-memory oracle, limits and recovery are signed.
Operator owns setting changes, reboot initiation, console/BMC recovery and final-state confirmation; automation is read-only after each boot.
Preserve logs; no log clearing, inferred OEM path/value, autonomous toggle/reboot, failed-state toggle, automatic retry or unapproved recovery.
Stop on boot timeout, missing memory/NUMA resources, GPU/fabric degradation, unexpected delta, hardware error or console/recovery loss.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/GPU/CPU/firmware/driver identity
Signed EGM semantic/control mapping, enabled/disabled state evidence and final-state requirement
Complete timestamped enabled and disabled lsmem, meminfo, memory-block and NUMA datasets
Calculated byte/range/node delta with approved units/tolerance and the larger-when-enabled check
GPU/fabric health plus preserved kernel/EDAC/AER/XID/SEL and OS-ready evidence for both boots
Workload-drain, operator/reboot, abort/recovery, final-state and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On a boot, memory-topology, GPU/fabric or error anomaly, stop after the first failure, preserve all evidence and hand control to the authorized operator. Use console/BMC and the signed Vera procedure to restore the required final state—disabled by the source sequence unless explicitly overridden—and verify OS readiness and baseline topology; never auto-toggle or retry.

source_conflict.reason: The Master consistently requires OS-visible host memory through lsmem. The old conflict came from DeepSeek/GPT V2 substituting GPU-local memory; the new record explicitly rejects that substitution and reconciles the oracle without changing source intent.

blocked.reason: The EGM two-state purpose, reversible method and safety boundary are identifiable; platform values and control mapping are execution prerequisites rather than an irreducible review blocker.
